## Music Video encoding and concurrency

- Fixed Music Video auto scaling so it only downscales sources above 1080p, with a Video tab toggle to disable it.
- Kept Music Video on HEVC Main10 when the selected encoder supports it and made Auto Crop configurable.
- Fixed subtitle handling for SRT, WebVTT, and extracted CEA captions, including caption language and disposition metadata.
- Disabled ASS/SSA conversion into MP4 `mov_text` output and changed subtitle defaults to include only SRT/SubRip and WebVTT.
- Made disabled video, audio, and subtitle processing copy those streams; turning all three off uses metadata-only mode.
- Added configurable encode concurrency. The default is 300 FPS per encode; a missing or zero threshold runs one job at a time.
